subject: general
question: Sangam literature was composed in which classical language?
solution:
The correct answer is:** '__Tamil__' **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Authors of the **Sangam canon**, The first known written **Tamil was called Sangam**, variously spelled cankam, chankam, and shangam.
 
• It is believed that Sangam was written between the** 1st and 4th centuries CE** in one of three literary schools (chankams) in Madurai, India.
 
• According to legend, the first Tamil Sangam was presided over by the ancient Tamil leader Siddhar Agastyar and held in Madurai. The Sangam Age describes this time frame.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangam is a term created by later academics.**
 
• There are **three Sangams mentioned in Tamil mythology:**
 
 
• The Madurai
 
• Kapadapura
 
• Thenmadurai
 
 
 
• There was a time when the poetry of the Sangam was considered to be that of the nobility. Sangam signifies "association" when taken at face value.
 
• Sangam literature is the literary term for the works of ancient Tamil authors. This writing system is the oldest example of literature from South India.
